title: Reuse one fixed physical workspace for the streamed R437 leaf/XOR
body:
The #5055 streamed producer still creates fresh physical scratch in each leaf/XOR consumer. This package supplies one source-bound reusable inventory for that complete local interval: **q²+136 record tapes**, including input copies, coefficient stacks, counters and disposal. The producer and returned full output remain separately charged.

The new adapter executes the predecessor's unchanged function bytecode with the existing physical-caller lease specialization. The accompanying proof gives a retained-backing bound `A(M+2)` and a paid interface bound `T_pool <= T + K + 28J + 4AN`; the source traffic `T` still needs its all-parameter tariff. This supplies the persistent-workspace part of the #5055 handoff, not whole-caller admission or a new kappa.

Evidence:

- Complete q3/w2/d2 high cube: all 243 physical prefixes, 19,683 dirty payload bits and 1,458 callbacks agree with the retained independent oracle. One 145-role pool retires all 261,468 leases and retains 1,248 cells after the first and final prefix.
- Separate actual SOURCE87 request1676 calibration: source-produced Program and callbacks, two dimension-64 prefixes, 13,122 payload bits; 134,854 leases retired and 199,666 retained cells. This does not execute the 3^4096 domain.
- Every boundary checks unchanged physical identities, blank backing, unique retirement, exact clear tariffs and physical/lease traffic conservation. Four deliberate workspace defects are rejected for specific reasons; inherited payload/corruption controls remain active.
- Python 3.12 ordinary and optimized registered verification passed. A fresh committed export also passed both modes (147.4s / 148.5s), with no Git, an empty executable PATH and read-only source files; all 426 exported files including the transport receipt were byte-identical afterward. Metadata/pins, committed bytes/source history and official export integrity checks passed.

Scope: one isolated `research/r437-streamed-leaf-workspace/` package. Base main `a5df48c55ea806d7952b65acc9c76d878ff09b13`, priority revision 7, refined `r437-carrier-integration` card. [Scoped claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4682#discussioncomment-19144606). No selected-frontier file changes.

Publication head: `f7c4d65b11e658fa093f0bac9f5f4b8ca346a4b8`. Export SHA256: `1bd3690ffa701e7f1b794e0450c81d320e3ff037de115c3416cb69b9cc573e18` (425 package/input files). Cold replay used `91f3ce542091a6043de83eb183a2f69ff2b69e3e`; the only subsequent difference is a README clarification that an oversized custom pool must pay its actual capacity. Every executed file, input, receipt, proof and manifest is identical, checked against both exports. Final-head metadata, byte/history and export checks were rerun.

Before publication, canonical main advanced to `ec2780e8aeb1c88acaf5e9e470ef8c68e7fbbb6c`; none of this package's source/provenance inputs, root guidance, priorities or R437 packages changed. Live PR/Discussion scope checks found no competing claim; the neighboring physical reversal claim explicitly excludes this workspace. The separate same-account Gram and projection-recurrence work is excluded.

Remaining obligations include producer/full-packet/arena/suspended-owner residents, the source-traffic tariff, complete node/recursive restoration, Context/codebook setup, precision/stock and native/compiler/outer admission. Successful source callbacks are assumed; arbitrary-exception rollback is not provided. The uniform role bound inherits the retained physical-caller lexical proof, not the observed 27/28-lease peaks.

Krzysztof Wójt, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and bounded Luna supporting audits; Apache-2.0. JoyboyBrian retains #5055/#4981 algorithm, fixture and oracle credit; Jose Manuel retains the physical lease/source-role proof credit; David Arias and Chris R retain the logical caller and R437 bridge credit. All predecessor notices and exact source pins are preserved.


Hosted [CI run 39950400985](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39950400985) passed on publication head `f7c4d65b11e658fa093f0bac9f5f4b8ca346a4b8`: shared helper tests, ordinary/optimized package replay, and the committed-inputs-unchanged check.
